note: The render-art workflow renders this queue only on the branch named in "branch" (a merge that carries this file to another branch renders nothing). To queue work: set "branch" to your own claude/** branch, list the tower levels, projectiles, enemies and gun-portrait levels ("portraits": {model: [levels]}, the clean Arsenal renders), commit and push. Each item renders in its own GitHub Actions job; the results are packed into public/art and committed back to that branch. Empty the lists when you are done.
